aeo.q: What is the AI Ops Sprint?
aeo.a: The AI Ops Sprint is a fixed, 10-business-day engagement that automates one workflow or ships one AI copilot inside your existing tools. It's built for ops teams buried in manual steps who need a quick, provable win — you get a working integration, lightweight documentation and a handover session before committing to anything larger.

aeo.q: How long does the AI Ops Sprint take?
aeo.a: Ten business days, start to finish. Days 1–2 cover kickoff, requirements and tool access; days 3–6 build and connect the automation or copilot; days 7–8 are user testing and refinements with your team; days 9–10 deploy to production with documentation, a handover session and go-live.

aeo.q: What's included in the AI Ops Sprint?
aeo.a: You get one workflow automated or one AI copilot shipped, scoped to complexity, deployed to your tools and ready to use. It includes lightweight documentation, a handover session and 30 days of bug-fix support. Multiple workflows, custom UI development and data migration sit outside the sprint and are scoped separately.

aeo.q: How much does the AI Ops Sprint cost?
aeo.a: Pricing is fixed and agreed before any work begins: {{price}}. There are no hourly rates or surprises — scope is locked at kickoff. Invoices are issued in EUR or GBP on 50% upfront, 50% on completion terms, and most clients recover the cost within two to four weeks through the hours saved on manual tasks.

faq.q: What's the difference from the Sprint?
faq.a: The Build includes multiple connected systems, proper error handling, monitoring, and an admin interface.

faq.q: Can you work with our internal APIs?
faq.a: Yes, we regularly integrate with custom APIs. We'll need documentation and test access.

faq.q: How do you handle approvals workflows?
faq.a: We build approval steps with configurable rules, escalation paths, and audit trails.
A dashboard showing automation runs, success rates, and alerts for failures.
Yes, a 2-hour training session is included, plus documentation for ongoing reference.
We work in 2-week sprints with demos, allowing for course corrections throughout.

aeo.a: The Automation Build is a production-grade automation that connects three to five of your tools with proper logging, alerting and retry handling. Built over four to six weeks, it includes an admin interface for configuration and suits teams that need reliable cross-tool workflows with approvals, reporting and error handling — not just a quick script.

aeo.q: How long does the Automation Build take?
aeo.a: Typically four to six weeks. Week 1 is a discovery workshop, process mapping and architecture; weeks 2–3 build the core automation, integrations and error handling; week 4 adds logging, monitoring and the admin interface; weeks 5–6 cover user testing, refinements, documentation, training and go-live.

aeo.q: What's included in the Automation Build?
aeo.a: A multi-system workflow connecting three to five tools, a logging and monitoring dashboard, a failure-alert system, a retry and error-handling strategy, an admin interface for configuration, full documentation and training, plus 60 days of bug-fix support. Mobile apps, legacy rewrites, BI/data-warehousing and 24/7 on-call support are out of scope.

aeo.q: How much does the Automation Build cost?
aeo.a: Pricing is fixed and agreed before any work begins: {{price}}, depending on the number of systems and complexity. There are no hourly rates — scope is locked after the discovery workshop. Invoices are issued in EUR or GBP on 50% upfront, 50% on completion terms, with most builds freeing one to two FTE-equivalent of capacity.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: Enterprise-grade automation has been out of reach for most SMEs — too expensive, too slow, and too risky to govern. We exist to change that: to give smaller teams the same leverage from AI and automation that large companies enjoy, without the enterprise overhead or the compliance headaches.

what.title: What we do
what.body: We scope, build and ship three things — each scoped and quoted per project, with a clear, measurable outcome:

items.title: Workflow automation
items.body: We connect your tools and automate the manual, repetitive steps — with logging, approvals and error handling so it runs reliably in production.

items.title: AI copilots
items.body: We ship focused AI assistants that draft, triage and answer inside your existing systems, so your team moves faster without switching tools.

items.title: MVPs
items.body: We take a product idea to a deployed, production-ready MVP — authentication, core features and analytics — so you can validate quickly.

items.title: Fixed scope, custom quote
items.body: Every engagement is scoped up front and quoted per project — no hourly billing, no surprises. You know exactly what's included before we start.

items.title: GDPR-by-design
items.body: Data protection is built in from day one: least-privilege access, optional DPAs, agreed retention and a clear audit trail — not bolted on afterwards.

items.title: Transparent by default
items.body: We publish the sub-processors we use, notify you of material changes, and keep our trust and compliance details open for review.

items.title: Delivered in weeks
items.body: We work in short, demo-driven cycles, so you see progress early and ship in weeks — not quarters.

cta.title: Ready to see what we'd automate first?
cta.body: Book a short call and we'll map the highest-impact workflow, copilot or MVP for your team — and give you a fixed scope within 48 hours.
